'''Ichium''' was the eighth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Solis Axum]] in the [[Axum system]],<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Azure sector/Legends|Azure sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ichium was a barren rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Axum system]] were introduced in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Axum star system in grid square L-9.<ref name="EA" />
